title: Additional monsoon storage volume
readable: Additional monsoon storage volume = Vd T2

symbols.definition: Volume of digested sludge m³ withdrawn per day
the storage in days, during monsoon

applicability: Section 6.4.5.1: where sludge drying beds alone are used and left open, monsoon rainfall causes environmental problems, so monsoon storage must be provided; this expression fixes the extra volume.
notes: Printed exactly as shown: 'Additional monsoon storage volume = Vd T2', with no multiplication sign and no bracket.
The symbol Vd is not redefined in this equation's own list; the definition reproduced above is the one printed for equation 6.1 on the same page ('Volume of digested sludge m³ withdrawn per day').

The only definition printed with this equation is the running line 'Where, T2 is the storage in days, during monsoon', which is not set as a symbol list. It is reproduced here as a symbol entry and flagged.
Transcriber note: the sentence ends 'Where, T2 is the storage in days, during monsoon' with no closing full stop.
